description_en: Creates a cache analysis task by calling the CreateCacheAnalysisJob operation
description_zh: 调用CreateCacheAnalysisJob接口，创建缓存分析任务
name: CreateCacheAnalysisJob

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Redis instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data node in the instance. Specify this parameter to query monitoring information of a specific node.
If you specify the BackupSetId parameter, this parameter is ignored. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例的数据节点ID，传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。
当您传入BackupSetId参数，系统会忽略此参数，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to obtain the backup file ID.

To specify multiple backup file IDs, separate them with commas (,), such as `12345,67890`.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically performs a backup and runs cache analysis on the backup file
parameters.help_zh:
备份文件ID，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html接口获取。

如需传入多个备份文件ID，请使用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如`12345,67890`。
如果不传入本参数，系统会自动执行备份并对该备份文件执行缓存分析
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The delimiters used to identify key prefixes. You do not need to specify this parameter if the default delimiters `:;,_-+@=|#` are used
parameters.help_zh: 用于识别Key前缀的分隔符。当分隔符为默认的`:;,_-+@=|#`时，不需要输入
parameters.name: separators

KeyInfo.description_en: The details of big keys, sorted in descending order by the number of bytes occupied by the key
KeyInfo.description_zh: 大Key详细信息，根据Key占用字节数降序排列

Bytes.description_en: The number of bytes occupied by the key

Count.description_en: The number of elements in the key

Encoding.description_en: The internal data type of the key

ExpirationTimeMillis.description_en: The expiration time of the key. Unit: milliseconds (ms). A value of 0 indicates that the key does not expire
ExpirationTimeMillis.description_zh: Key过期时间，单位：毫秒（ms），0表示不过期

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the data node in the instance

JobId.description_en:
The ID of query cache analysis task.
You can use this parameter to query query cache analysis task. Because creating a cache analysis task takes some time, the analysis result is not immediately returned when you call this operation. Use this parameter together with the [DescribeCacheAnalysisJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180983.html） operation to query the analysis result
JobId.description_zh:
缓存分析任务ID。
此参数可用于查询缓存分析任务使用，当您调用该API时，由于创建缓存分析任务需要一定的时间，不会立即返回分析结果，您需要通过此参数，结合[DescribeCacheAnalysisJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/180983.html）接口，查询具体的分析结果

Message.description_en:
The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the data node in the instance

TaskState.description_en:
The status of the cache analysis task. Valid values:

BACKUP: The system is performing a backup.
ANALYZING: The system is analyzing the backup file.
FINISHED: The analysis is complete.
FAILED: An error occurred
TaskState.description_zh:
缓存分析任务的状态：

BACKUP：备份中。
ANALYZING：分析中。
FINISHED：分析完成。
FAILED：出现错误

Message.description_en:
The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
